name: hud-pro
description: One quiet line above your message box, in the terminal and the desktop app: how much of the 5-hour and weekly usage allowance is used and when it refills, how full the chat's memory is, and the chat's ≈cost; /hud full shows the details

band.title: Usage line above your message box
band.description: auto: only warnings in the desktop app (it shows the 5-hour and weekly percent itself), the full line in the terminal. always: the full line. alerts: only an allowance or the chat's memory that needs a look (amber or red, or close to running out), without the cost; nothing while all is calm. /hud band changes it from the message box
